# Instrument registry (generated by tools/registry.py --view — do not hand-edit)

Facts live in `knowledge/ane/`; **instruments live here**. Read this before writing any
new probe: if a canonical instrument exists, reuse it. Add an entry when you add a tool.

Status: **canonical** = the one to use · **duplicate** = exists, prefer its canonical twin · **superseded** = kept only as an evidence artifact · **unclassified** = TODO.
